CustomField.label: Check Description
CustomField.description: Optional extra context shown when a user hovers over (or keyboard-focuses) the "Check Title" on the record page. Use it to explain, in plain language, what the check looks at and why it matters. It is shown only on hover/focus - never inline on the row.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Extra context shown on hover over the check's title. Explain what the check looks at, in plain language.
